name: Tachibana Asuka
source:
3rd year student of the high school connected to Hakurouin University. Vice captain of the Superhero club.
She's often mistaken for a teacher, but she is actually just a typical high school girl who loves to go shopping with friends on her days off. Saying "Mature Woman" is forbidden around her.
She has the superpower "Shadow Dive" which she can use to travel through shadows.
